purpose: Define the operator approval artifact required before any future data writer can consider skipped records acknowledged.

approvedBy.description: Neutral operator role or team name; avoid personal identifiers in public artifacts.

requiredAcknowledgements: Rejected records will not be written.
Manual-review records will not be written.
Unsupported cached sources will not be written.
Skipped counts were reviewed against the SQL preview summary.
This approval does not enable database mutation by itself.

retention.notes: Approval records can contain operational metadata and should be stored with release evidence, not committed as real approvals.
